response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg INNER JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) as share_percentage FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY record_count DESC;
